family: JIS A 5373 けた橋げた (pretensioned T-girders, Japan)
description: Japanese standard precast pretensioned T-girders per JIS A 5373 Annex B Recommended Specification B-1: types AG18-AG24 (A live load) and BG18-BG24 (B live load), spans 18-24 m @ 1 m pitch. Cross-section per MLIT Chubu Regional Bureau design guideline (図-5-III-41): top flange 800 wide x 160 thick with 20 mm side returns and 35 mm haunch; web+bottom 300 wide constant; depth 900-1300 mm per type. Girder c/c spacing max 1.08 m; skew >= 70 deg; concrete 50 N/mm2 (36 at transfer).

sources.section_dims: MLIT Chubu Regional Bureau 道路橋設計要領 第5章橋梁 v2014.03, 表-5-III-10 + 図-5-III-41 (citing the PCCEN handbook, JIS A 5373:2004): https://www.cbr.mlit.go.jp/road/sekkeiyouryou/pdf/cb005_kyouryou_v201403.pdf
sources.thr: THR/PCCEN Tohoku プレテンション橋げた設計施工のポイント: https://www.thr.mlit.go.jp/road/sesaku/manual/20170323point2.pdf
